# Art

Art carries visual, plastic, architectural and performative works whose composition makes a relation perceptible. A record treats material, scale, viewpoint, repetition, enclosure, interval and figure as operations rather than as a stock language of symbolism.

Each work receives creator, title, date, medium, location or collection, source image, rights state, close description and exact essay use. Reproductions remain distinct from plates newly composed for the essay.
